title: Building a Personal Guitar Repertoire: Creating and Using a Songbook for Beginners
summary: JustinGuitar’s lesson advocates assembling a personalized repertoire songbook to support practice, performance, and collaboration. It walks through a practical workflow: use a display folder to hold printable lyric-and-chord sheets, compile your favorite songs into a single repertoire for regular practice, and share printed sheets with other musicians during jams. The video also covers portable digital options (saving PDFs in cloud storage like Dropbox for phone access) and emphasizes keeping a lean, manageable set of songs (around 20) to avoid overwhelm. The core message is that a well-constructed rhythm of physical and digital song sheets improves readability, memory, and the ability to play along with others, whether at home, at parties, or in gigs, with tools such as a dashboard or beginner app to organize songs.
